# The Compass · MBTI Cognitive Functions Quiz

> An interactive, single-page browser game for learning Jung's eight cognitive
> functions and the four attitude pairs. Tap function slots on a compass ring —
> emoji slots bloom a circular wheel of choices, name slots open a smooth
> dropdown — then check your arrangement and reveal each opposite pair.
> Free, no login, no tracking. Sounds are synthesised in the browser.

## What it teaches

Eight cognitive functions, each with an emoji, an archetype name, and the MBTI
types that use it as dominant or auxiliary:

- **Ni — Seer** 🔮 (INFJ · INTJ) — introverted intuition
- **Ti — Architect** 🧩 (INTP · ISTP) — introverted thinking
- **Si — Keeper** 📜 (ISFJ · ISTJ) — introverted sensing
- **Te — General** ⚙️ (ENTJ · ESTJ) — extraverted thinking
- **Se — Surfer** 🏄 (ESFP · ESTP) — extraverted sensing
- **Fe — Host** 🤝 (ENFJ · ESFJ) — extraverted feeling
- **Ne — Inventor** 🎈 (ENFP · ENTP) — extraverted intuition
- **Fi — Monk** 🕯️ (INFP · ISFP) — introverted feeling

## The four attitude pairs (opposites across the centre)

1. **Far & Near** — Ni ↔ Se
2. **New & Known** — Ne ↔ Si
3. **True & Together** — Ti ↔ Fe
4. **Works & Worth** — Te ↔ Fi

## How to play

1. Tap an empty emoji circle on the ring — a circular wheel of the eight
   functions blooms around it; tap one to place it.
2. Tap an empty name pill — a smooth dropdown lists the eight names.
3. Picking a function already used elsewhere swaps the two slots, so every
   function appears exactly once per ring half.
4. Press **Check** — green stays, rose moves. In "Opposites only" mode any
   rotation is correct as long as each pair faces its true opposite.
5. **Hint** places one function; **Reset** clears the ring.

## Locales

English (default, auto-detected), 繁體中文, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어, Español,
Français, Deutsch, Português (BR). Switch with the language menu; choice is
remembered locally.

## Meta

- Single static page, works without a server: https://mbti-compass.slower.workers.dev/
- No cookies, no analytics, no accounts.
- Unofficial. Not affiliated with MBTI® or The Myers-Briggs Company.
